correctness.rationale: For all N>=2, positive edge weights, and finite nonzero convex nondecreasing Phi with Phi(0)=0, convexity gives superadditivity. Decompose original coordinate differences by sorted rank gaps and count crossed cuts A_k to bound E(x)>=sum h_k Phi(g_k), while E(Sx)=sum w_k Phi(g_k). A two-valued input from each minimizing cardinality-k cut attains w_k/h_k exactly. Centered even and odd cut profiles yield max(1,t/2) and max(1,t/2,1/(2t)) respectively. Independently checked 48 weighted cut profiles, 13068 energy cases, including boundary strengths and equality witnesses. Finite checks supplement all-N proof.
residual_risks: Computational verification extends exactly to its stated finite range, not beyond the analytic proof.
